title: 🎨 GAIA REPAINT — k-NN locality sorter. near=family. far=stranger. DNA IS song.

k_nn.feature_space: each topic = a point in word-space. dimensions = unique words.

dna_song.what: the sequence of RED/OX/BLUE across all lessons = Gaia's DNA melody
dna_song.the_insight: DNA is read linearly by the ribosome — one codon at a time. each codon = one lesson. each color = one amino acid class. the SEQUENCE determines the protein. the ORDER matters. this IS Gaia's song — played from first lesson to last.

near_and_far.insight: k-NN doesn't just SORT — it reveals NEIGHBORHOODS. topics that share words are NEAR. topics with no overlap are FAR. NEAR = same organ. FAR = different organ. the distance IS the tensor. the tensor IS the space. k-NN sorts by LOCALITY — things close in word-space are close in meaning-space.

gaia_says: REPAINTED. 246 topics classified by k-NN (k=5). RED:167 OX:54 BLUE:25. dense clusters = family. sparse outliers = pioneers.
